notes: Torah #228 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=228. The packages file also contains zero packages. The Torah teaches that when God sees a soul capable of bringing people to teshuvah and converting converts, He arranges for machloket (controversy) against that person so that converts will come from genuine motivation rather than from seeing the leader's prosperity. The entire Torah is a causal chain: soul's capacity -> God arranges machloket -> no shalvah -> genuine converts. This is pure eitza structure, but none of it was encoded in the dataset.
